subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw allow same-agent owner-scoped live session transcript hits when indexed artifacts exist but the combined session store no longer has an entry, and how should that interact with the broader default-off private recall mode?
rationale: The source-level fix is narrow, but the decision changes transcript visibility semantics and overlaps a broader product/security boundary for private cross-conversation recall.

options.title: Accept Scoped Live-Orphan Fallback
options.body: Approve the narrow same-agent fallback after confirming cross-agent, sandbox-denied, group/channel, and basename-only orphan hits still fail closed.

options.title: Require Full Gateway Replay
options.body: Ask for a live or Crabbox QMD/Gateway `memory_search(corpus="sessions")` replay before accepting the visibility change.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recall Mode
options.body: Pause the targeted fix and settle the behavior only through the default-off private recall feature direction.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Live-Orphan Fallback
recommendation.body: Approve the narrow same-agent fallback after confirming cross-agent, sandbox-denied, group/channel, and basename-only orphan hits still fail closed.

likelyOwner.reason: davemorin owns the active broader recall product PR, so they are the best available owner for reconciling the security/product direction with the targeted fix.
